ablation: B's own stated sigma on the SAME primary stream with the CALIB-01 Gaussian bridge (computed from the reference JSONLs): the no-ensemble control. If the ensemble's sigma_ens does not beat B's sigma, disagreement adds nothing over the stated uncertainty.
baseline: Sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology on the same o sequence (the CALIB-01 baseline, recomputed on fresh-seed data). The o sequence is the primary's realized events: identical to families (a)/(b)/(d), directly comparable.
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect='none', action_mode default, 10 episodes x 5 seeds {73601,73602,73603,73604,73605}. Primary ArchB drives the env (constructor seed = s; per-episode reset seeds identical to the reference runs). 4 shadow members (m=1..4, constructor seed = derive_seed(s, m, 'ensemble-member')) shadow the primary: per tick, shadow.replay_actions=[a_primary]; shadow.act(obs); env.step(a_primary); primary.update; shadow.update(obs, a_primary, r, done, info). Shadows learn from the primary's transitions; their predictions differ only by init seed. Primary's new JSONL must be byte-identical to the reference EXP-FP-011X log (consistency check); o_t comes from the reference stream. Deterministic; stdlib only.
decision_use_protocol: SHARED (program step 3), runs ONLY if this family passes the gate. DU1 (D3 defer): online shadow ensemble; per tick if p_D3 > 0.5 take uniform-random action (seeded stream derive_seed(s,0,'defer'); shadows replay the EXECUTED action), else the primary's action. DU2 (D4 retrieval gate): per tick when a correction is available, apply iff p_D4 > 0.5 else skip (RetrievalGate 'p_ext' policy reading external p). Arms paired on 4 fresh seeds {73701,73702,73703,73704} x 10 episodes changing_rule. Metric: mean episode return. Win: seed-mean Delta(gated-blind) > 0 AND >=3/4 seeds agree on sign. Firing rate reported; rate 0 = decision-inert finding. Family is DECISION-USEFUL iff gate pass AND >=1 DU win; calibrated-but-inert caps at INTEGRATED.

estimator_spec.honesty: p_t is a function of PRE-OUTCOME predictions only (the members' xhat/rhat/uhat). No member's realized error at tick t enters p_t. This is the fix for the voided EXP-FP-0112 design.
estimator_spec.members: primary (constructor seed s) + 4 shadows (constructor seeds derive_seed(s, m, 'ensemble-member'), m=1..4). N=5 predictors.
estimator_spec.outcome_o: o_t = primary's realized event (from the reference stream; same o as families (a)/(b)/(d)).
estimator_spec.probability: Gaussian bridge with sigma_ens (the CALIB-01 mappings, sigma swapped): D1: p=erf(EPS_OBS/(sigma*sqrt2)); D2: p=erf(EPS_RW/(sigma*sqrt2)); D3: p=erfc(TAU_FAIL/(sigma*sqrt2)); D4: p=Phi(uhat_bar/sigma). Clamped to [1e-9, 1-1e-9].

sigma_ens.D1_D3: mean per-dimension std of member xhat vectors (obs prediction disagreement)
sigma_ens.D4: std of member uhat scalars; uhat_bar = mean of member uhats

estimator_spec.sigma_floor: max(sigma, 1e-9); if sigma<=0 the bridge outputs 0.5.

frozen_gates: G0 fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new/modified code, pre-run
G1 primary-trajectory consistency: the re-run primary JSONL must be byte-identical to the reference EXP-FP-011X log, else VOID
G2 hash-chained receipt via harness.write_receipt + verify_chain
gate: SHARED GATE (program step 1): PASS iff Brier_ens < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains (>=3/4 bar follows lab precedent EXP-FP-0070/71/72). corr(sigma,|err|) reported, no threshold. REJECT otherwise: full negative-result entry, move on. No exceptions, no 'promising direction' softening.
hypothesis: Pre-outcome ensemble disagreement (shadow-mode, N=5) as the sigma in the CALIB-01 Gaussian bridge beats sequential climatology on >=3/4 calibration domains: Brier_ens < Brier_climo.
limitations_preregistered: Single env (changing_rule); ensemble diversity comes only from predictor init seeds (same architecture).
Shadow members learn from the primary's trajectory (their training data is the primary's); disagreement reflects init-conditional model uncertainty, not data uncertainty.
maturity_mapping: Gate pass -> EXECUTED with measured Brier skill. DU win -> CAUSAL. Gate fail -> REJECTED + NR entry.
null: Brier_ens >= Brier_climo on >=2/4 domains (fails the >=3/4 bar): pre-outcome ensemble disagreement carries no probabilistic information beyond the running base rate.
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_ens vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology), scored by benchmarks/calibration_battery.py score_domain on the pooled tick stream (primary's o, ensemble's p). PASS iff Brier_ens < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains. A domain scoring UNMEASURABLE under CALIB-01's gates counts as not-beaten. corr(sigma_ens,|err|) reported per domain (Pearson, pooled scored ticks); no threshold (supplementary, per program step 1).
redesign_note: Supersedes the VOIDED EXP-FP-0112 instrument. The voided design's p_t used members' REALIZED errors at tick t (contemporaneous-outcome leakage: sibling runs' outcomes are correlated with the primary's, so p_t peeked at the answer). The voided run's numbers are not interpreted for any claim; the leakage catch is recorded as a methodological negative result.
seed_freshness: 73601-73605 (same env seeds as the other families; the primary trajectory is the reference stream, so o is identical across families). No overlap with calib 73101-73105 or any other experiment's seeds.
